title: Path Anatomy
prompt: Implement file_info(p) receiving a Path and returning a dict with keys name, stem, suffix, and parent (as str).

tests.name: splits a report path
tests.code:
from pathlib import Path
info = file_info(Path('data/reports/q1.csv'))
assert info['name'] == 'q1.csv'
assert info['stem'] == 'q1'
assert info['suffix'] == '.csv'
tests.hint: name/stem/suffix come straight from the Path API.

tests.name: parent is the folder
tests.hint: parent is a Path — convert with str().
